.qc-cache/hireops-workspace-2026-10-03-r10/rules/harbor-webdev-rubric-qc/SKILL.md (Delivery profile: network public in both phases, never report it; Known false positives: demo passwords in the brief and ${VAR} templates in task.toml are intentional)
evidence: Workbook row 9 (current 'Quality Checks' sheet) asks for sane CPU/memory and no secret literals, with network_mode = "public" explicitly correct; quality-checks.md:44 adds: cpus/memory_mb present and sane, no secret literal under [environment], network_mode = "public", [environment].docker_image absent, allow_internet omitted. Frozen task/task.toml:20-24 is exactly '[environment] build_timeout_sec = 600.0 / network_mode = "public" / cpus = 2 / memory_mb = 4096' - identical to the frozen template task.toml:20-24 and staged-task-contract.md. No docker_image and no allow_internet key anywhere in task.toml (grep). No secret literal under [environment]; the only credential-like lines are task.toml:34-35 in [verifier.env] ('ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN = "${OPENROUTER_API_KEY}"', 'ANTHROPIC_API_KEY = ""'), which are the frozen ${VAR} template, not literals, and not in the agent environment. The agent image task/environment/Dockerfile is byte-identical to the template Dockerfile (diff: no differences): FROM node:22-bookworm-slim, apt installs ca-certificates git procps sqlite3, npm -g express@5.1.0 better-sqlite3@12.4.1 (pinned), COPY instructions/ and assets/, no ENV/ARG secrets, no build-time credentials. Secret scan of environment/ (regex for api key/secret/token/password/sk-/bearer/AKIA/ghp_/xox and 32+ char token strings) finds only the brief's demo password 'Hireops!2026' at environment/instructions/hireops_rules.md:11, which the skill lists as an intentional house-convention false positive; seed_data.json contains no password/token fields or long opaque strings, and its emails use only reserved .example domains (hireops.example, candidates.example, mail.example). 'Nothing secretly needs an install' (internal sheet): integration.md:3-4 states Express and better-sqlite3 are available through NODE_PATH, matching the Dockerfile's global installs and ENV NODE_PATH. 2 CPUs / 4 GiB is the standard contract allocation and ample for one Node 22 Express+SQLite process plus an agent. Counterexample attempts: a broken app could not exploit this row (it is pure environment configuration); a conforming app is not disadvantaged since network is public and both runtime packages are preinstalled. The internal sheet's older 'no-network' wording conflicts with the current public sheet, skill delivery profile and template; per the skill and task instructions the public posture is correct and not flagged. Unmeasured: no agent-image build or resource-usage run was performed in this review (none required for this static configuration row; image pinning by digest belongs to row 15).
